pathConstruction: inputs/f<zero-padded-index>-<distributed x padding>.ts; padding is distributed in index order so the aggregate relative path length is exactly 34,941 UTF-16/ASCII code units
fixtureLifetime: A fresh fixture is created under the host temporary directory for one harness execution and removed by that harness after all conditions complete.

harnesses.initial: initial-curve-harness.ts is the byte-identical initial direct-SCC harness snapshot (Git blob a30cdf15d86268a99309d6d35acf926fece9d8dc); it has no dependency on final runtime modules.
harnesses.runtime: runtime-remeasure-harness.ts is the later final-runtime harness and imports scanWithScc plus planSccBatches; it is intentionally not executable against the initial source baseline.
